login.title: Sign in with <accent>email</accent>
login.intro: No password. Enter your email and we will send a 6-digit code to confirm it is you.
login.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.codeHint: No email? Check your Spam or Promotions folder.
login.resent: A new code is on its way. The previous one no longer works.
login.terms: By signing in you agree to the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
login.asideNote: Every tool still works without signing in. Your files are still processed only in your browser.
